chain.label: Low-altitude flight along confined river corridor
chain.trigger: the accident airplane's altitude varied from 500 to 700 feet for the remainder of the flight

chain.label: 13-knot easterly crosswind at turn location
chain.trigger: the winds at 700 feet were from 095º at 13 knots

chain.label: Pilots chose to attempt a 180° turn rather than request ATC clearance or climb
chain.trigger: the pilots could have chosen to contact ATC and request clearance to transit through the class B airspace instead of turning around in the East River exclusion area

caused_by.evidence: approached the northern end of the East River exclusion where the floor of the class B airspace transitioned from 1,100 feet to the surface, effectively requiring either a 180° turn to reverse course or an ATC clearance

chain.label: Turn begun from mid-channel with insufficient bank angle, then steepened to complete it
chain.trigger: the actual turn was accomplished with a bank angle of 40º to 45º...Because the turn was initiated at 40º to 45º rather than the minimally required 50º, the pilots increased the bank angle of the airplane to attempt completion of the 180º turn

caused_by.evidence: the pilots increased the bank angle of the airplane to attempt completion of the 180º turn
the 13-knot easterly wind caused a measurable westward drift

chain.label: Aerodynamic stall during steepened turn
chain.trigger: it is likely that the pilots put the airplane into an aerodynamic stall while pulling through the turn

caused_by.evidence: if the bank angle exceeded 61º, the airplane wing would aerodynamically stall

chain.label: Loss of control (wobbling, pitch-down, steep bank)
chain.trigger: the wings were “wobbling,” like the pilot was fighting for control. The airplane then pitched down and to the right and descended below his field of view

caused_by.evidence: witnesses...described the motion of the airplane as “wobbling” from side to side and reported that it was in a pitch-down attitude and at a steep bank angle

chain.label: Impact with apartment building
chain.trigger: the airplane impacted a 520-foot tall apartment building at 524 East 72nd Street, 333 feet above street level

caused_by.evidence: the airplane impacted a 520-foot tall apartment building
low altitude over the river left little margin to recover before striking the building

chain.label: Fatal and ground injuries
chain.trigger: were killed. One person on the ground sustained serious injuries, two people on the ground sustained minor injuries

caused_by.evidence: were killed. One person on the ground sustained serious injuries, two people on the ground sustained minor injuries
